context: Grow-line visit. Threshold holder: stops taking UPI at month-end to stay under 1 lakh.
source: scripted text transcript (audio deferred; Kannada in Roman script)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Namaskara Meena avare. Ee visit service quality ge record aagtide, parvagilla tane?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Business hegide? Festive orders jaasti idya?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Orders chennagi ide. Blouse stitching, lehenga alterations, ella. Naanu shop expand maadbeku antha idini, innondu machine, ondu helper.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Super. Neevu UPI alli payments tagotira alva, aadre month-end alli kammi kaanstide.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haudu, last week of the month naanu UPI tagolla, cash maatra. Kelavaru helidru one lakh daati hodre fee barutte antha. Adakke month-end alli QR tegedidtini.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay. Adu poorti correct alla. Fee ella payment ge barolla.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haudaa? Hagadre actual aagi nange eshtu fee barutte? Month ge eshtu cut aagutte?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Nimma sales numbers inda exact amount lekka maadi kalistini. Cash alli tagondre aa sales nimma digital record alli barolla, adu kooda nodi.
